lead_raw_text:
The structure of Y₄Mg₂Al₂ (YMgAl₂) crystallizes in the orthorhombic space group Amm2 (No. 38), with a 12-atom unit cell distributed over five independent Wyckoff orbits. CrystalNN geometry-only analysis shows Al, Mg, and Y centers each with 12 geometric neighbors, all described as close-packed-like local arrangements with neighbor distances from about 2.90 to 3.49 Å. The geometric neighbor graph forms a single three-dimensional component spanning all 12 sites. Validated polyhedron-sharing analysis identifies Al–Y, Mg–Y, and Al–Al 12-vertex coordination polyhedra exhibiting corner-, edge-, and face-sharing contacts.
